programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.summary: A five-year professional programme combining design studio work, practical internship and critical thinking, with an emphasis on sustainable technologies.
outcomes: Think critically, work in teams and present design work
Carry out planning and design work independently

structure.intro: Ten semesters over five years. Design studio is the core of the programme, with progressively more complex projects and group design exercises. Students also complete study tours across Bhutan and a six-month internship.

modules.name: Building Materials and Construction
modules.description: Properties of building materials and how buildings are put together.

modules.name: History of Architecture
modules.description: The development of architecture across periods and cultures.

modules.name: Computer Applications
modules.description: Software tools used for drafting, modelling and presentation.
